about.title: About Lux Salon
about.subtitle: Our story, our values, and our commitment to your beauty.
about.story_p1: Founded in 2016, Lux Salon was born from a passion for celebrating the beauty of Ethiopian hair in all its natural glory. We set out to create a salon that combines world-class techniques with a deep understanding of the unique needs of Ethiopian and African hair textures.
about.story_p2: Over the years, we have grown from a small studio to Addis Ababa's premier hair destination, serving thousands of clients and becoming synonymous with quality, trust, and style.
about.value_quality_desc: We never compromise on the quality of our products or service.
about.value_care_desc: Every client is treated like family, with patience and personal attention.
about.value_expertise_desc: Our team regularly trains to stay ahead of the latest trends and techniques.
about.value_inclusivity_desc: We celebrate all hair types, textures, and backgrounds.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services and policies.
faq.q1: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a1: You can book online through our website, call us at +251 911 234 567, or message us on WhatsApp. Online booking is available 24/7.
faq.q2: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a2: We recommend booking at least 2–3 days in advance for regular services, and 2–4 weeks in advance for bridal services.
faq.a3: We require at least 24 hours notice for cancellations. Late cancellations or no-shows may be charged a fee.
faq.q4: Do you use natural or organic products?
faq.a4: We use a range of premium products suited to different hair types. We carry several natural and ammonia-free options. Please inform your stylist of any sensitivities.
faq.q5: How long does a braiding appointment take?
faq.a5: Braiding times vary significantly based on the style and length. Box braids typically take 3–5 hours. We recommend allowing extra time.
faq.a6: Yes! We offer services for children and welcome families. Our stylists are patient and experienced with kids.
faq.q7: Do you offer a trial for bridal hair?
faq.a7: Absolutely. We always recommend a trial session 2–4 weeks before your wedding day. The bridal package includes the trial.
faq.q8: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a8: We accept cash (ETB), Telebirr, and bank transfer. We do not currently accept card payments.

policies.title: Salon Policies
policies.subtitle: Please review our policies before your visit.
policies.cancellation_body: We kindly ask for at least 24 hours notice if you need to cancel or reschedule your appointment. This allows us to accommodate other clients. Cancellations made with less than 24 hours notice, or no-shows, may be subject to a 50% service fee.
policies.arrival_body: Please arrive 5–10 minutes before your appointment. If you are more than 15 minutes late, your appointment may be shortened or rescheduled. We will do our best to accommodate you.
policies.children_body: Children are welcome for their own appointments. For safety and comfort of all clients, we ask that accompanying children remain seated and supervised.
policies.health_body: We sanitize all tools and surfaces between every client. Please inform your stylist of any scalp conditions, allergies, or sensitivities before your service begins.
policies.refund_body: We want you to love your hair! If you are unsatisfied with your service, please let us know before you leave. We will work to make it right. Refunds for services already performed are not issued.
